# ==========================================================================
# BioMistral-7B -- SEPARATE venv (venv_biomistral).
# Full fine-tuning of a 7B decoder under DeepSpeed ZeRO-3. torch is installed
# separately in setup_env_biomistral.sh (torch==2.5.0, CUDA 12.4) to match the
# CUDA toolchain used by the ModernBERT venv.
#
# NOTE: we use DeepSpeed's *torch* AdamW (optimizer type "AdamW") and NO CPU
# offload, so DeepSpeed does NOT need to JIT-compile its CPUAdam/FusedAdam ops --
# this avoids the usual on-cluster CUDA-compile headaches.
# ==========================================================================
